name: ckz_eff2500_timegate_novelty
_design: TIME-GATED LoRA, novelty arm (no init). lora_start_sigma = sigma at/below which the adapter is full; ABOVE it (early/high-noise structure steps) the adapter is OFF (lora_low default 0.0) so the BASE MODEL decides the melody. Then cKz timbre is painted in the late/low-sigma steps. Hypothesis: as gate drops from 1.0 (control = current behavior) toward 0.2, melodies diversify across seeds while timbre stays cKz. Find the crossover where it's novel AND still reads cKz. Rate timbre + melody + note 'varied?'.
